tasks.title: Add assembleDiffCodeReviewGrounding + DiffGroundingDeps (working-tree diff, HEAD^ fallback)
tasks.summary: In src/workflow/code-review/grounding.ts add assembleDiffCodeReviewGrounding(repoPath, deps?) — a peer of assembleCodeReviewGrounding — plus a DiffGroundingDeps seam (workingTreeDiff + lastCommitDiff over the git_diff builtin) and a real default. It derives the changed set from the working-tree diff; when that is empty it falls back to gitDiffTool { from:'HEAD^' } (last commit); when HEAD has no parent it falls back to the root commit's contents; and it emits a CodeReviewGrounding whose symbols[] is one per-file pseudo-ChangedSymbolSummary (kind:'file', name:file, hunks in signature, empty edges; a binary marker where no textual hunks). Returns { grounding, changedFiles }. Read-only; hunks bounded by git_diff maxBytes. An empty result is a valid grounding (symbols:[]), not an error; a git failure on BOTH paths propagates.
acceptanceChecks: assembleDiffCodeReviewGrounding(repoPath, deps?) returns { grounding, changedFiles } with one pseudo-ChangedSymbolSummary per changed file
non-empty working tree uses the working-tree diff and does NOT call the HEAD^ seam
empty working tree falls back to { from:'HEAD^' }; HEAD-with-no-parent falls back to the root commit; both-empty yields symbols:[]
a binary changed file yields a pseudo-symbol with a binary marker (no hunks) still present in changedFiles
the assembler is read-only (never mutates / reindexes / commits) and a both-paths git failure propagates

tasks.title: Replace the decline branch with the diff-only degraded path
tasks.summary: In src/mcp/code-review-step/handler.ts replace the s9 decline exit (errorResult('review-declined', ...) at ~handler.ts:211) with: call deps.assembleDiffGrounding(repo); on a both-paths git failure return a CodeReviewStepError (code 'diff-unavailable', retryable:true) and write NO record; otherwise saveState({subject, grounding, groundingMode:'degraded'}) and return next:'emit_judgements' over the diff grounding. In the judgements turn, when the loaded state is marked groundingMode:'degraded', drive runCodeReview with groundingMode:'degraded' + capVerdictAtWarn:true; otherwise (graph path) pass neither. The fresh path + proceed:true poll + graph judgements turn stay byte-identical to s9 (ac6).
